carriedForwardOpenQuestions.text: **Snapshot mechanism.** Replace `git status` with a content hash over the state subtree in both packets, or the guard tests nothing.

**Retry on DEVIATION.** 002's "first failed turn ends the run" [SOURCE: specs/sk-doc/065-conversation-playbook-scenarios/002-conversation-runner/spec.md:171] has to become attempt-aware, or 006's NFR-R02 becomes unimplementable.

**Stage marks.** One of the two vocabularies has to yield. Adding DEVIATION and N/A to 002's verdict set is the smaller edit only if a stage status file is also added; otherwise 006 needs a documented derivation.

**Which doc owns S8, S9 and S12?** 006's stage content and 002's turn/scratch model disagree in three places. Either 002 gains a check-only stage, an action list per turn and a named second project, or 006 changes its stage count and its `env` mechanism. Decide before either is built, because every one of the three is a format change in 001's closed key set.
**Probe additions for T001.** Verify `devin list`, what `devin --resume` with no id does, and whether Codex needs `--dangerously-bypass-hook-trust` for hooks to fire in a fresh project.
